exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
Usage of build:
  -backend string
    	how the process tree is snapshotted: auto (DMTCP in place, else CRIU), criu or dmtcp (default "auto")
  -compress
    	store the process images and weights as zstd frames, for a snapshot restored from network storage (up decodes them as it stages a local copy)
  -criu string
    	host CRIU binary to use instead of the image's
  -cuda-backend string
    	how CUDA state moves: driver (libcuda's checkpoint API), cli (cuda-checkpoint), or auto (driver when usable) (default "auto")
  -cuda-checkpoint string
    	host cuda-checkpoint to use instead of the image's
  -cuda-execution string
    	CUDA restore: auto (everything concurrent when no collective links the processes), serial, parallel (only the workers concurrent) or parallel-all (default "auto")
  -cuinterpose string
    	cuInterpose build directory (default: cuinterpose/ next to warmctl)
  -dmtcp-dir string
    	directory of DMTCP's programs, for the dmtcp backend (default "/opt/warmctl/dmtcp/bin")
  -dmtcp-plugin string
    	warmctl's fdkeep DMTCP plugin, for the dmtcp backend (default "/opt/warmctl/dmtcp/lib/libdmtcp_fdkeep.so")
  -docker string
    	Docker socket (default "/var/run/docker.sock")
  -gpus string
    	GPU indices, e.g. 0-7
  -id string
    	run id (default: the output's name)
  -in-place
    	bake in this container, without Docker (a pod without privileges: docs/dmtcp.md)
  -model-dir string
    	model directory on this host
  -no-verify
    	canary only warns
  -output string
    	snapshot directory to create
  -part-bytes int
    	size of a weights part (default 1073741824)
  -profile string
    	profile id or YAML file
  -profile-dir value
    	extra directory of profile YAML files (repeatable)
  -progress string
    	progress format: plain or jsonl (default "plain")
  -ready-timeout duration
    	how long the engine may take to load (default 1h30m0s)
  -scratch string
    	accepted for compatibility
  -set value
    	profile override vllm.<flag>=<value>, env.<NAME>=<value> or ipc=<mode> (repeatable)
  -state-dir string
    	state directory (default "/var/lib/warmctl")
  -test-cpu
    	end-to-end test on a CPU host: no GPU devices, no io_uring check
  -threads int
    	pool copy threads per rank (default 4)
error: flag: help requested
